scope.definition: canonical scope = fixed git-tracked snapshot at HEAD (git ls-files). Audit-written artifacts and any other non-ignored untracked file are reported as supplemental/unscored and are excluded from every statistic.
scope.vendored_note: No tracked vendored/third-party source trees exist. node_modules, .venv and app/node_modules are git-ignored and were not enumerated. data/raw/external/datagov/*.geojson are downloaded upstream datasets (tracked, data category), not source.

coverage_report.note: These are two different runs of the same suite. The worktree artifact is stale (timestamp 2026-11-22) and reports 96/4076 covered; the fresh audit execution (timestamp 2026-11-23) reports 3894/4076. Neither is a code finding; both are reported verbatim from the XML headers.

dead_code_candidates_unconfirmed.method: identifier word-boundary grep across all measured source files; a symbol with zero references outside its defining file is listed. NOT proof of dead code: dynamic access (getattr, importlib, string refs), framework entry points, test-only imports and re-exports are not resolved.

methodology_notes.loc: lines = physical lines (splitlines). code_lines excludes blank and comment-only lines (python: tokenize; ts/tsx/mjs: lexical //, /* */ single-line tracking which misclassifies comment text inside template literals).
methodology_notes.nesting: max_nesting_estimate is block-statement nesting depth, NOT cyclomatic complexity: it ignores boolean operators, comprehension filters and expression lambdas.
methodology_notes.python_parser: ast (stdlib) on 3.12 via uv run python
methodology_notes.web_parser: typescript compiler API v5.9.3 loaded from app/node_modules (read-only); .astro files: frontmatter block parsed as TS, template markup not analyzed

supplemental_indexes.note: Mechanical, exhaustive indexes generated for all in-scope source files. Rows are automated scans and are NOT semantically reviewed; absence of a row is not proof of absence of behaviour (dynamic dispatch, runtime registration, framework magic are not resolved).
